title: Bob's Burgers Episodes
hook: This week we're exploring Bob's Burgers dialogue! Thank you to Steven Ponce for the data, and a blog post demonstrating how to visualize the data! See the {bobsburgersR} R Package for the original transcript data, as well as additional information about each episode!
questions: How have dialogue metrics changed over the seasons?
Can you find any patterns not shown in Steven Ponce's original visualization?
